project.name: Restaurant marketing website
project.objective: A marketing website for a restaurant to attract new customers

sequences.description: Only small content/style tweaks - should stay LOW drift.
requests: Change the header font to something bolder.
Add three more dishes to the menu page.
Swap the hero image for a new photo.

sequences.description: A couple of real out-of-scope asks mixed with small tweaks - should land around MODERATE.
requests: Add three more dishes to the menu page.
Add a downloadable PDF version of the menu.
We'd like a table reservation system with real-time availability.

sequences.description: The full 'marketing site quietly becomes an operations platform' story - should reach CRITICAL.
requests: Can customers create an account and log in?
We want a loyalty points system for repeat customers.
Add a staff dashboard where our team can update the menu.
Build an admin panel to manage orders and inventory.
Can you build an online ordering system for takeout?

sequences.description: A mix of vague asks and one real out-of-scope request - should stay LOW to MODERATE, not spike just because of vagueness.
requests: Can you make the site feel more premium?
Make the site faster and more modern.
We'd like customers to be able to book a table online with real-time availability.
